specifications.name: CapDAG.Query.admits
specifications.definition:
fun q c =>
  q.input.admits c.input ∧
    q.output.admits c.output ∧ CapDAG.effectOk c.effect q.effect ∧ TaggedUrn.refinesClosed c.other q.tags

specifications.name: CapDAG.Query.consuming
specifications.definition:
fun input tags =>
  { input := CapDAG.Ask.covers input, output := CapDAG.Ask.unknown, tags := tags, effect := CapDAG.Effect.unspecified }

specifications.name: CapDAG.Query.grade
specifications.definition:
fun q c =>
  if q.exactly.admits c then CapDAG.Grade.exact
  else if q.admits c then CapDAG.Grade.guaranteed else if q.mayAdmit c then CapDAG.Grade.possible else CapDAG.Grade.none

specifications.name: CapDAG.Query.mayAdmit
specifications.definition:
fun q c =>
  q.input.mayAdmit c.input ∧
    q.output.mayAdmit c.output ∧ CapDAG.effectOk c.effect q.effect ∧ TaggedUrn.meetsClosed c.other q.tags

specifications.name: CapDAG.Query.ofCall
specifications.definition:
fun r =>
  { input := CapDAG.Ask.covers r.input, output := CapDAG.Ask.within r.output, tags := r.other, effect := r.effect }

specifications.name: CapDAG.Query.ofPattern
specifications.definition:
fun p =>
  { input := CapDAG.Ask.within p.input,
    output := if CapDAG.unconstrainedMedia p.output then CapDAG.Ask.unknown else CapDAG.Ask.covers p.output,
    tags := p.other, effect := p.effect }

specifications.name: CapDAG.Query.ofRequest
CapDAG.Query.producing
specifications.definition:
fun output tags =>
  { input := CapDAG.Ask.unknown, output := CapDAG.Ask.within output, tags := tags, effect := CapDAG.Effect.unspecified }

specifications.name: CapDAG.capAccepts
specifications.definition:
fun pattern request =>
  TaggedUrn.refines request.input pattern.input ∧
    TaggedUrn.refines pattern.output request.output ∧
      (pattern.effect = CapDAG.Effect.unspecified ∨ pattern.effect = request.effect) ∧
        TaggedUrn.refines request.other pattern.other

specifications.name: CapDAG.capScore
specifications.definition: fun c => 10000 * TaggedUrn.urnScore c.output + 100 * TaggedUrn.urnScore c.input + TaggedUrn.urnScore c.other

specifications.name: CapDAG.effectOk
specifications.definition: fun candidate request => request = CapDAG.Effect.unspecified ∨ candidate = request

specifications.name: CapDAG.fits
specifications.definition: fun pattern cap => (CapDAG.Query.ofPattern pattern).admits cap

specifications.name: CapDAG.flows
specifications.definition: fun a b => TaggedUrn.refines a.output b.input

specifications.name: CapDAG.mayFlow
specifications.definition: fun a b => TaggedUrn.meets a.output b.input

specifications.name: CapDAG.mayServe
specifications.definition: fun candidate request => (CapDAG.Query.ofRequest request).mayAdmit candidate

specifications.name: CapDAG.rankingKey
CapDAG.select
specifications.definition: fun candidates request => List.foldl (CapDAG.selectStep request) none candidates

specifications.name: CapDAG.serves
specifications.definition: fun candidate request => (CapDAG.Query.ofRequest request).admits candidate

specifications.name: TaggedUrn.Constraint.allows
specifications.definition:
fun x x_1 =>
  match x, x_1 with
  | TaggedUrn.Constraint.missing, x => True
  | TaggedUrn.Constraint.unconstrained, x => True
  | TaggedUrn.Constraint.optionalNot p, s => s ≠ TaggedUrn.KeyState.set p
  | TaggedUrn.Constraint.present, s => s ≠ TaggedUrn.KeyState.unset
  | TaggedUrn.Constraint.presentNot p, s => s ≠ TaggedUrn.KeyState.unset ∧ s ≠ TaggedUrn.KeyState.set p
  | TaggedUrn.Constraint.exact p, s => s = TaggedUrn.KeyState.set p
  | TaggedUrn.Constraint.absent, s => s = TaggedUrn.KeyState.unset

specifications.name: TaggedUrn.comparable
specifications.definition: fun a b => TaggedUrn.refines a b ∨ TaggedUrn.refines b a

specifications.name: TaggedUrn.equivalent
specifications.definition: fun a b => TaggedUrn.refines a b ∧ TaggedUrn.refines b a

specifications.name: TaggedUrn.meets
specifications.definition:
fun a b =>
  a.scheme = b.scheme ∧ ∀ (key : String), key ∈ a.keys ++ b.keys → TaggedUrn.tagMeets (a.tag key) (b.tag key) = true

specifications.name: TaggedUrn.meetsClosed
specifications.definition:
fun a b =>
  a.scheme = b.scheme ∧
    ∀ (key : String), key ∈ a.keys ++ b.keys → TaggedUrn.tagMeets (a.tag key).closed (b.tag key) = true

specifications.name: TaggedUrn.refines
specifications.definition:
fun a b =>
  a.scheme = b.scheme ∧ ∀ (key : String), key ∈ a.keys ++ b.keys → TaggedUrn.tagMatch (a.tag key) (b.tag key) = true

specifications.name: TaggedUrn.refinesClosed
specifications.definition:
fun a b =>
  a.scheme = b.scheme ∧
    ∀ (key : String), key ∈ a.keys ++ b.keys → TaggedUrn.tagMatch (a.tag key).closed (b.tag key) = true

specifications.name: TaggedUrn.urnScore
specifications.definition: fun u => (List.map (fun pair => TaggedUrn.tagScore pair.snd) u.tags).sum

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Gate.opened_spec
claims.statement:
∀ (window : Nat),
  (CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Gate.opened window).available = window ∧ (CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Gate.opened window).closed = none

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.acquire_spends
claims.statement:
∀ {g g' : CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Gate} {n : Nat},
  g.acquire n = CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Acquire.acquired g' →
    g'.available + n = g.available ∧ g.closed = none ∧ g'.closed = none

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.batch_positive
claims.statement: ∀ (window : Nat), 0 < (CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Window.opened window).batch

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.close_keeps_first
claims.statement: ∀ (g : CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Gate) (first second : String), (g.close first).close second = g.close first

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.closed_releases
claims.statement:
∀ (g : CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Gate) (reason : String) (n : Nat),
  ∃ why, (g.close reason).acquire n = CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Acquire.closed why

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.consume_accounts
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Window),
  w.consume.window.pending + w.consume.grant = w.pending + 1 ∧
    w.consume.window.remaining = w.remaining + w.consume.grant ∧ w.consume.window.batch = w.batch

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.continued_accounts
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Window),
  w.continued.grant = 1 ∧
    w.continued.window.remaining = w.remaining + 1 ∧
      w.continued.window.pending = w.pending ∧ w.continued.window.batch = w.batch

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.flush_grants_pending
claims.statement:
∀ (w : CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Window),
  w.flush.grant = w.pending ∧
    w.flush.window.pending = 0 ∧ w.flush.window.remaining = w.remaining + w.pending ∧ w.flush.window.batch = w.batch

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.grantTarget_sound
claims.statement:
∀ (streams : List (Option String)) (named target : Option String),
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.grantTarget streams named = some target → target ∈ streams

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.grant_after_close
claims.statement: ∀ (g : CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Gate) (reason : String) (n : Nat), (g.close reason).grant n = g.close reason

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.grant_unblocks
claims.statement:
∀ (g : CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Gate) (n granted : Nat),
  g.closed = none →
    n ≤ g.available + granted → ∃ g', (g.grant granted).acquire n = CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Acquire.acquired g'

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.negotiate_comm
claims.statement: ∀ (ours theirs : Nat), CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.negotiate ours theirs = CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.negotiate theirs ours

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.negotiate_refuses_zero
claims.statement: ∀ (ours theirs : Nat), CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.negotiate ours theirs = none ↔ ours = 0 ∨ theirs = 0

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.negotiate_within
claims.statement:
∀ {ours theirs window : Nat},
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.negotiate ours theirs = some window → 0 < window ∧ window ≤ ours ∧ window ≤ theirs

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.pending_below_batch
claims.statement: ∀ (w : CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Window), 0 < w.batch → w.consume.window.pending < w.batch

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.violation_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (w : CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Window), w.arrive = CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Arrival.violation ↔ w.remaining = 0

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.waits_iff_spent
claims.statement:
∀ (g : CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Gate) (n : Nat),
  g.acquire n = CapDAG.Bifaci.Credit.Acquire.wait ↔ g.closed = none ∧ g.available < n

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.code_ofCode
claims.statement: ∀ {n : Nat} {f : CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType}, CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType.ofCode n = some f → f.code = n

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.control_is_not_flow
claims.statement:
CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType.credit.isFlow = false ∧
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType.cancel.isFlow = false ∧ CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType.closeStream.isFlow = false

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.deliver_is_the_next_run
claims.statement:
∀ {r r' : CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Reorder} {seq limit : Nat} {seqs : List Nat},
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Ordered r →
    r.accept seq limit = CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Accepted.deliver r' seqs →
      seq = r.expected ∧
        seqs = List.range' r.expected seqs.length ∧
          seqs ≠ [] ∧
            r'.expected = r.expected + seqs.length ∧
              CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Ordered r' ∧ ∀ (n : Nat), n ∈ r.held → n ∈ seqs ∨ n ∈ r'.held

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.held_within_limit
claims.statement:
∀ {r r' : CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Reorder} {seq limit : Nat},
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Ordered r → r.accept seq limit = CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Accepted.hold r' → r'.held.length ≤ limit

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.hold_keeps_order
claims.statement:
∀ {r r' : CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Reorder} {seq limit : Nat},
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Ordered r →
    r.accept seq limit = CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Accepted.hold r' →
      r'.expected = r.expected ∧
        CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Ordered r' ∧
          r.expected < seq ∧
            (∀ (n : Nat), n ∈ r'.held ↔ n = seq ∨ n ∈ r.held) ∧
              r'.held.length = r.held.length + 1 ∧ r.held.length < limit

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.ofCode_code
claims.statement: ∀ (f : CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType), CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType.ofCode f.code = some f

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.ordered_start
claims.statement: CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Ordered CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Reorder.start

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.stale_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (r : CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Reorder) (seq limit : Nat),
  r.accept seq limit = CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.Accepted.stale ↔ seq < r.expected

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.terminal_is_flow
claims.statement: ∀ (f : CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType), f.isTerminal = true → f.isFlow = true

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.admission_shortens_line
claims.statement:
∀ {s s' : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State} {waiter : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Waiter},
  s.admitNext = some (waiter, s') → s'.queue.length < s.queue.length

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.admit_iff_next
claims.statement:
∀ (s s' : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State) (ticket : Nat),
  s.admit ticket = some s' ↔ ∃ waiter, s.admitNext = some (waiter, s') ∧ waiter.ticket = ticket

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.advertised_running
claims.statement:
∀ (pool : String) (configured : Nat) (available : Option Nat),
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.advertised true pool configured available = CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.effective configured available

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.arrive_admits_iff
claims.statement:
∀ {s : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State} {chain : List String},
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Ticketed s →
    s.unknown chain = none →
      ((∃ after, s.arrive chain = CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Arrival.admitted after) ↔
        CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Settled s ∧ s.hasRoom chain = true)

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.arrive_keeps_settled
claims.statement:
∀ {s : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State} {chain : List String},
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Ticketed s →
    CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Settled s →
      s.unknown chain = none →
        match s.arrive chain with
        | CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Arrival.admitted after => CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Settled after
        | CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Arrival.queued after ticket position => CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Settled after
        | CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Arrival.unknownPool name => True

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.arrive_settled
claims.statement:
∀ {s : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State} {chain : List String},
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Ticketed s →
    CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Settled s →
      s.unknown chain = none →
        s.arrive chain =
          if s.hasRoom chain = true then
            CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Arrival.admitted
              (have __src := s.take chain;
              { pools := __src.pools, queue := __src.queue, next := s.next + 1 })
          else s.join chain

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.arrive_ticketed
claims.statement:
∀ {s : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State} (chain : List String),
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Ticketed s →
    match s.arrive chain with
    | CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Arrival.admitted after => CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Ticketed after
    | CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Arrival.queued after ticket position => CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Ticketed after
    | CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Arrival.unknownPool name => True

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.canary
claims.statement:
∀ (configured : Nat) (available : Option Nat),
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.advertised false CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.all configured available = 1

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.chain_includes_all
claims.statement: ∀ (cap : String) (shared : List (String × List String)), CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.all ∈ CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.chain cap shared

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.chain_shared
claims.statement:
∀ (cap : String) (shared : List (String × List String)) (name : String) (members : List String),
  (name, members) ∈ shared → cap ∈ members → name ∈ CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.chain cap shared

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.chain_starts_with_cap
claims.statement: ∀ (cap : String) (shared : List (String × List String)), (CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.chain cap shared).head? = some cap

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.effective_static
claims.statement: ∀ (configured : Nat), CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.effective configured none = configured

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.effective_unlimited_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (configured : Nat) (available : Option Nat),
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.effective configured available = 0 ↔ configured = 0 ∧ (available = none ∨ available = some 0)

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.effective_within_available
claims.statement:
∀ (configured reported : Nat),
  reported ≠ 0 →
    CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.effective configured (some reported) ≤ reported ∧
      CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.effective configured (some reported) ≠ 0

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.effective_within_configured
claims.statement:
∀ (configured : Nat) (available : Option Nat),
  configured ≠ 0 →
    CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.effective configured available ≤ configured ∧
      CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.effective configured available ≠ 0

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.hasRoom_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (s : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State) (chain : List String),
  s.hasRoom chain = true ↔ ∀ (p : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Pool), p ∈ s.pools → p.name ∈ chain → p.hasRoom = true

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.heldBack_le
claims.statement: ∀ (s : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State) (name : String), s.heldBack name ≤ s.queue.length

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.join_known
claims.statement:
∀ {s : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State} {chain : List String},
  s.unknown chain = none →
    s.join chain =
      CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Arrival.queued (s.enqueue chain).fst s.next ((s.enqueue chain).fst.position s.next)

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.leave_removes_only_it
claims.statement:
∀ (s : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State) (ticket : Nat) (waiter : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Waiter),
  waiter ∈ (s.leave ticket).queue ↔ waiter ∈ s.queue ∧ waiter.ticket ≠ ticket

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.patience_available
claims.statement: ∀ (grace : Nat), CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.patience none grace = CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Patience.unbounded

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.patience_exhausted_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (elapsed grace : Nat),
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.patience (some elapsed) grace = CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Patience.exhausted ↔ grace ≤ elapsed

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.patience_is_the_remainder
claims.statement:
∀ (elapsed grace remaining : Nat),
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.patience (some elapsed) grace = CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Patience.atMost remaining →
    remaining + elapsed = grace ∧ 0 < remaining

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.position_zero_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (s : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State) (ticket : Nat),
  s.position ticket = 0 ↔ ∀ (w : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Waiter), w ∈ s.queue → w.ticket ≠ ticket

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.release_undoes_take
claims.statement: ∀ (s : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State) (chain : List String), (s.take chain).release chain = s

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.release_within
claims.statement:
∀ {s : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State} (chain : List String),
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Within s → CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Within (s.release chain)

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.setCapacity_others
claims.statement:
∀ (s : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State) (name other : String) (capacity : Nat),
  other ≠ name → (s.setCapacity name capacity).pool other = s.pool other

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.setCapacity_pool
claims.statement:
∀ (s : CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State) (name : String) (capacity : Nat),
  ∃ p, (s.setCapacity name capacity).pool name = some p ∧ p.capacity = capacity

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.ticketed_empty
claims.statement: CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.Ticketed CapDAG.Bifaci.Pools.State.empty

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.check_prefix
claims.statement:
∀ (frames more : List CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.Emitted) (violation : CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.Violation),
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.check frames = some violation → CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.check (frames ++ more) = some violation

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.control_always_written
claims.statement:
∀ (over : Bool) (frame : CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType),
  frame.isFlow = false → CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.write over frame = CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.Write.send false

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.ledger_unmoved
claims.statement:
∀ (remaining : Int) (frame : CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType) (granted : Nat),
  frame ≠ CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType.chunk ∧ frame ≠ CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType.credit →
    CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.ledger remaining frame granted = remaining

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.live_is_routed
claims.statement: ∀ (endedLately : Bool), CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.dispose true endedLately = CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.Disposition.route

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.live_writes
claims.statement:
∀ (frame : CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType),
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.write false frame = CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.Write.send frame.isTerminal

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.noRoute_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (live endedLately : Bool),
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.dispose live endedLately = CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.Disposition.noRoute ↔
    live = false ∧ endedLately = false

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.over_suppresses_flow
claims.statement:
∀ (frame : CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType),
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.write true frame = CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.Write.suppress ↔ frame.isFlow = true

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.phase_after
claims.statement:
∀ (p : CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.Phase) (frame : CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType),
  p.after frame = if frame.isFlow = true then CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.Phase.streaming else p

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.straggler_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (live endedLately : Bool),
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.dispose live endedLately = CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.Disposition.straggler ↔
    live = false ∧ endedLately = true

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.streaming_stays
claims.statement:
∀ (frame : CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType),
  CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.Phase.streaming.after frame = CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.Phase.streaming

claims.name: CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.terminalOf_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (frame : CapDAG.Bifaci.Flow.FrameType), (CapDAG.Bifaci.Request.terminalOf frame).isSome = frame.isTerminal

claims.name: CapDAG.Exec.accepts_decides
claims.statement:
∀ (p c : CapDAG.Exec.WfCap),
  CapDAG.Exec.accepts p c = true ↔ CapDAG.fits (CapDAG.Exec.WfCap.toCap✝ p) (CapDAG.Exec.WfCap.toCap✝ c)

claims.name: CapDAG.Exec.comparable_decides
claims.statement:
∀ (a b : CapDAG.Exec.WfCap),
  CapDAG.Exec.comparable a b = true ↔
    CapDAG.capAccepts (CapDAG.Exec.WfCap.toCap✝ a) (CapDAG.Exec.WfCap.toCap✝ b) ∨
      CapDAG.capAccepts (CapDAG.Exec.WfCap.toCap✝ b) (CapDAG.Exec.WfCap.toCap✝ a)

claims.name: CapDAG.Exec.dispatch_decides
claims.statement:
∀ (c r : CapDAG.Exec.WfCap),
  CapDAG.Exec.dispatch c r = true ↔ CapDAG.serves (CapDAG.Exec.WfCap.toCap✝ c) (CapDAG.Exec.WfCap.toCap✝ r)

claims.name: CapDAG.Exec.effectOk_decides
claims.statement: ∀ (c r : CapDAG.Effect), CapDAG.Exec.effectOk c r = true ↔ CapDAG.effectOk c r

claims.name: CapDAG.Exec.equivalent_axiswise
claims.statement:
∀ (a b : CapDAG.Exec.WfCap),
  a.effect ≠ CapDAG.Effect.unspecified →
    b.effect ≠ CapDAG.Effect.unspecified →
      (CapDAG.Exec.equivalent a b = true ↔
        TaggedUrn.equivalent a.input.urn b.input.urn ∧
          TaggedUrn.equivalent a.output.urn b.output.urn ∧
            TaggedUrn.equivalent a.other.urn b.other.urn ∧ a.effect = b.effect)

∀ (a b : CapDAG.Exec.WfCap),
  CapDAG.Exec.equivalent a b = true ↔
    CapDAG.capAccepts (CapDAG.Exec.WfCap.toCap✝ a) (CapDAG.Exec.WfCap.toCap✝ b) ∧
      CapDAG.capAccepts (CapDAG.Exec.WfCap.toCap✝ b) (CapDAG.Exec.WfCap.toCap✝ a)
